description.zh:
是否自动续费。取值：

- **true**：自动续费
- **false**：不自动续费（默认）
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal for the premium bandwidth plan. Valid values:

- **true**.

- **false** (default).
The ID of the instance that you want to renew.
The renewal period. By default, instances are renewed on a monthly basis. Valid values: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, and 12.

description.zh:
续费时长的时间单位。取值：
- Month（默认）
- Year
description.en:
The unit of the renewal period. Valid values:

- Month (default)

- Year

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens renew-arm-server-instance --instance-id yourInstance_ID --period 1 --period-unit Month --auto-renew true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ens RenewARMServerInstance --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId yourInstance_ID --AutoRenew true --Period 1 --PeriodUnit Month
